cropping: Existing 500-sample (2 s at 250 Hz) grid-localized windows; no raw re-cut. Selected subsets of complete body strokes perturb pool composition.
channels: Four channels in stored order; acquisition metadata map 0,1,2,3 for all 63 development trial/REST recordings. No new physical sensor inspection.
filters: Third-order zero-phase Butterworth 0.5-12 Hz; temporal demeaning; lags 0,5,...,30; 28x28 covariance; tangent mapping.
duplicates: Unique recording/stroke identities; no marked duplicate field in W02 archive.
overwrite_protection: Output directory and adjacent log absent; runner uses mkdir(exist_ok=False). Preserve failures and use new retry names.
test_access: Development wears only. Sealed W07/W10/W12 absent in supplied data and refused by runner. No C170 data read.
epochs: Not applicable: k-means and logistic regression; no neural training or epoch selection.
experiment: 25 body conditions x 2 prefix modes x 2 cluster-count modes x 8 pre-specified class subsets x 2 naming methods = 1600 real rows, 8000 null rows.
preprocessing: Train-only logistic scaler/model on 8 complete wears. Held-out tangent reference and local z-scoring fitted transductively on the selected pool only; no excluded stroke used in pool adaptation.
null: Zero model retrained on recording-block class permutations; support relabeled by seeded per-recording four-class permutation. Same pools as real rows.
metrics: Accuracy and macro-F1 over true classes present; absent-class recall null. No bootstrap intervals. Real and null predictions saved.
